verdict.rationale: Plaid's first-party docs have a dedicated webhooks API reference. It states that Plaid sends webhooks to tell you programmatically about changes to Items and about the status of asynchronous processes, and the Transactions product explicitly uses webhooks to keep data up to date. That covers the core of subscribing to events. Missing for 10: details on how webhook URLs are configured or subscribed, a catalog of event types, signature verification and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
